effective_date_basis: The last day of the stated closing or mourning period in the order's own text.
ending_pattern: The order closes offices or excuses employees on a stated day, or orders mourning or half-staff display for a stated period. It ends at the close of that day or period by its own terms.

exceptions_savings.assessment: None ordinarily (state none_after_bounded_search) unless pay or leave was granted, which is an accrued effect.

exemplar.wpa_summary: Executive Departments and independent Establishments in the Districtof Columbia ordered closed on Dec. 26, 1931. 1932 CSR 65.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order sets a recurring holiday or a standing rule (for example every Saturday afternoon).
No day or period is stated.
quoted_clause:
December 22, 1931
Executive Order
CHRISTMAS , 1931
It is hereby ordered that the several executive departments and independent
Government establishments in the District of Columbia , including the Government
Printing Office and the Navy Yard and stations, be closed on Saturday, December
26 , 1931 , and all clerks and other employees in the Federal service in the District
of Columbia, except those who may for special public reasons be excepted from the
provisions of this order, or those whose absence from duty would be inconsistent
with the provisions of existing law, are hereby excused from duty on that day.

scope.note: Membership is a machine lead; each order is decided by an agent, row by row.
